Issue 4540 -- DXIL validation of the i1 groupshared module
generated by make-validator-case.py; every command below was executed as shown

  repro.hlsl                  expect ?       the i1 groupshared module -- the question
  control-no-static.hlsl      expect accept  the i32 groupshared module -- must be accepted
  control-tgsm-overflow.hlsl  expect reject  64KB groupshared -- must be rejected, proving groupshared rules run

`-Fo` makes dxc validate and sign the container, so the exit status IS the
validator's answer. Each release validates with the dxil.dll beside its dxc.exe.
